objective: Independently review the implementation and test evidence and issue a non-integrating recommendation.

context.summary: Bounded review unit in the issue #15 decomposition fixture.

outputs.description: An evidence-backed recommendation without merge authority.

policies: Reviewer must differ from candidate worker

uncertainty.statement: Passing visible tests may not cover all integration risks.
uncertainty.resolution_strategy: Record residual risk and request additional evidence when needed.

verification_policy.acceptance_rule: Review provenance, scope, tests, and residual risk are explicit.

validators.description: Check that the review addresses behavior, scope, evidence, and residual risks.

evidence_requirements.description: Retain the independent review and reviewer identity.
Attest that the reviewer did not produce the candidate.
